name: Webz.io
tagline: Real-time web, news, and dark web data APIs for developers
description: Webz.io (formerly Webhose.io) provides REST APIs that deliver structured data from news sites, blogs, forums, reviews, and dark web sources. Developers query by keywords, filters, and time ranges to monitor media, brand mentions, and threat intelligence at scale.

auth.details: API key via token query parameter (?token=YOUR_API_KEY); self-serve signup on webz.io

use_cases: search recent news articles by keyword
monitor brand mentions across news and blogs
fetch structured web data for media monitoring
query dark web sources for threat intelligence
